formula: e = actual_at_own_first_candidate - original_linear_prediction_at_same_candidate; m = abs(e); internal raw prediction interval = [L + m - e, U - m - e]
phases: final and every_accepted_state candidate restrictions only; baseline admission remains original
reference_rule: Reuse old D point only for identical full physical candidate and input/control/reference/response/acceptance context; otherwise measure own first candidate. Rejected point is not an accepted reference state.
binding: Frozen original task, response, baseline inputs and controls; witness original problem, first candidate, valid AC readback and restoration evidence
objective_and_response: Unchanged slopes, normalization, permissions, original-baseline movement objective and centers-first active-face policy
acceptance: Unchanged original specification and independent original requirements; never evaluate against corrected internal bounds
conflict_rule: If any corrected interval is empty, stop with no candidate. No clipping, reduced margin, extra solve or relaxed acceptance.
scope_limit: Single-point residual is not a global error bound; no new response sampling.
fallback: If no certified model specification, one D-only correction may be executed and must not count as LLM success.
